html:
Nyanganyatjara is the name the map gives to an Aboriginal people of the Great Victoria Desert in Western Australia, north of the Nullarbor Plain.

Little is written about them under this name. They would have spoken a form of the Western Desert language, like their neighbours on the map such as the Tjalkadjara and Mandjindja. Desert families lived by moving between rockholes and soaks, hunting and gathering. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: Nyanganyatjara is the name the map gives to an Aboriginal people of the Great Victoria Desert in Western Australia, north of the Nullarbor Plain.
